sourceTitle: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
originalTitle: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: We’re planning our next internal security sprint at OpenAI, bringing new researchers and security partners together with our own teams to use our models to test and strengthen our systems. We’re partnering with Cathedral, whose researchers will use OpenAI’s models alongside our teams to challenge our defenses, bringing differentiated expertise and approaches to finding weaknesses and helping us protect our platforms.
blocks.en: We’re planning our next internal security sprint at OpenAI, bringing new researchers and security partners together with our own teams to use our models to test and strengthen our systems. We’re partnering with Cathedral, whose researchers will use OpenAI’s models alongside our teams to challenge our defenses, bringing differentiated expertise and approaches to finding weaknesses and helping us protect our platforms.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 正在筹备下一轮内部安全攻坚行动，邀请更多研究人员和安全合作伙伴与我们的团队携手，利用我们的模型测试并加固系统。我们正与 Cathedral 合作，其研究人员将与我们的团队一起使用 OpenAI 模型，检验我们的防御能力。他们将运用独到的专业知识和方法发现薄弱环节，帮助我们保护平台。

blocks.text: “OpenAI is setting an important example by partnering with outside security firms and using its own models to continuously test and strengthen its defenses. Every company should be thinking about how to put these capabilities to work. We’re excited to collaborate with OpenAI’s teams, combining their models and security expertise with our research to find weaknesses, test fixes and strengthen this approach to continuous defense.”
blocks.en: “OpenAI is setting an important example by partnering with outside security firms and using its own models to continuously test and strengthen its defenses. Every company should be thinking about how to put these capabilities to work. We’re excited to collaborate with OpenAI’s teams, combining their models and security expertise with our research to find weaknesses, test fixes and strengthen this approach to continuous defense.”
blocks.zh: “OpenAI 与外部安全公司合作，并利用自身模型持续测试和加强防御，树立了重要的榜样。每家公司都应该思考如何将这些能力付诸实践。我们很高兴能与 OpenAI 的团队合作，将他们的模型和安全专长与我们的研究相结合，发现薄弱环节、测试修复方案，并完善这种持续防御的方法。”
Gavin Kliger，Cathedral 首席执行官兼联合创始人

blocks.text: We’re also making improvements to our Security Bug Bounty program including more than quadrupling our rewards for critical findings. We want researchers to challenge our assumptions and help strengthen both our systems and the methods we use to defend them.
blocks.en: We’re also making improvements to our Security Bug Bounty program including more than quadrupling our rewards for critical findings. We want researchers to challenge our assumptions and help strengthen both our systems and the methods we use to defend them.
blocks.zh: 我们也在改进我们的 安全漏洞赏金计划，包括将严重漏洞的发现奖励提高至原来的四倍以上。我们希望研究人员挑战我们的既有假设，帮助我们加固系统，同时改进防御方法。

blocks.text: This is part of our ongoing effort to use AI to continuously find and fix weaknesses in our systems. Our last sprint showed what this approach can deliver. We dedicated 25% of our product engineers to finding and fixing weaknesses in our systems. Using Codex, engineers investigated findings, reproduced vulnerabilities in isolated environments and prepared patches for review.
blocks.en: This is part of our ongoing effort to use AI to continuously find and fix weaknesses in our systems. Our last sprint showed what this approach can deliver. We dedicated 25% of our product engineers to finding and fixing weaknesses in our systems. Using Codex, engineers investigated findings, reproduced vulnerabilities in isolated environments and prepared patches for review.
blocks.zh: 我们一直在利用 AI 持续发现并修复系统中的薄弱环节，这次行动也是其中的一部分。上一轮攻坚行动已展现出这种方法的成效。我们投入了 25% 的产品工程师，专门查找并修复系统中的薄弱环节。工程师利用 Codex 调查发现的问题，在隔离环境中复现漏洞，并编写补丁以供审核。

blocks.text: We’re building on that work because traditional cyber defenses alone are no longer sufficient. Recent incidents across the industry show how quickly threats can emerge and how important it is to build continuous defensive loops to find and fix weaknesses before attackers do.
blocks.en: We’re building on that work because traditional cyber defenses alone are no longer sufficient. Recent incidents across the industry show how quickly threats can emerge and how important it is to build continuous defensive loops to find and fix weaknesses before attackers do.
blocks.zh: 我们正以这些工作为基础继续推进，因为仅靠传统的网络防御手段已不足以应对威胁。近期行业内发生的多起事件表明，威胁可能迅速出现。因此，建立持续运转的防御闭环、赶在攻击者之前发现并修复薄弱环节至关重要。

blocks.text: Keeping the defender’s window open requires organizations to use frontier cyber capabilities to harden their systems. We’re using our most capable models to strengthen our own defenses and making them available to Daybreak customers. We’ve committed $1 billion in subsidized access over six months for frontline defenders protecting essential services and digital infrastructure. We’re also sharing our architecture and lessons from the last sprint, alongside our blueprint for empowering cyber defenders across industry and government.
blocks.en: Keeping the defender’s window open requires organizations to use frontier cyber capabilities to harden their systems. We’re using our most capable models to strengthen our own defenses and making them available to Daybreak customers. We’ve committed $1 billion in subsidized access over six months for frontline defenders protecting essential services and digital infrastructure. We’re also sharing our architecture and lessons from the last sprint, alongside our blueprint for empowering cyber defenders across industry and government.
blocks.zh: 要让防御者的窗口期持续开放，各组织就必须利用前沿网络安全能力加固自身系统。我们正在利用能力最强的模型加强自身防御，并向 Daybreak 客户开放这些模型。我们已承诺，在六个月内为保护关键服务和数字基础设施的一线防御者提供总计 10 亿美元的模型使用补贴。我们还在分享上一轮攻坚行动中采用的架构与经验，以及帮助业界和政府部门网络防御者提升能力的蓝图。

blocks.text: We’ll keep advancing our models, using them to strengthen our own systems, and expanding access for trusted defenders. Keeping the defender’s window open will take action across the industry, and that work needs to start now.
blocks.en: We’ll keep advancing our models, using them to strengthen our own systems, and expanding access for trusted defenders. Keeping the defender’s window open will take action across the industry, and that work needs to start now.
blocks.zh: 我们将持续提升模型能力，用它们加固自身系统，并让更多值得信赖的防御者能够使用这些模型。要让防御者的窗口期持续开放，需要整个行业共同行动，而这项工作必须从现在开始。
